description: Loadout main window. core:default is intentionally NOT granted (T8 §3.2, 2026-08-15): it hands over core:image, core:menu, core:path, core:resources, core:tray and core:webview, none of which this app calls, and a permission nobody calls is a hole nobody notices. Neither shell nor fs is granted either (T8 §3.3): one flaw in the markdown this app renders in Memory would turn a shell permission into arbitrary code on the machine. Rust runs the agents; the webview asks by name. The windows field below is matched on the window LABEL from tauri.conf.json, not on the shown name.
